decision: cloned fork HT2Knock/kimaki and branched bun-runtime
why: work in the user fork, not the upstream clone

decision: finish condition is: cd kimaki and bun run bun:check exits 0 with bot and CLI on bun
why: needs a check that reads pass or fail on the real artifact

decision: vitest runs under bun once zod is inlined in the deps
why: decides whether the whole suite can run on bun
result: FAILED before inline with undefined z.object, passed after

decision: mac is reachable with bun 1.4.2 and node 26.11.1, no pnpm
why: mac is the 10 CPU machine for the heavy suite run

decision: knockon has 4 CPUs and 15 GB RAM
why: full suite on knockon is worker capped and slow

decision: fork had push access and clean baseline build
why: a blocked push at the end would waste the night
evidence: git push --dry-run origin main, pnpm build

decision: OpenCode V2 is a compiled Bun binary, so kimaki/src/plugin already runs on Bun in production
why: the plugin is in the OpenCode process and is Bun tested today

decision: all native and voice deps load on bun: libsql, opusscript, werift, prism-media, discordjs voice
why: native modules were the top unknown for a bun port
evidence: bun -e import of each, libsql file create and select
result: all OK, libsql file query returned a row

decision: Node baseline suite has one pre-existing failure in voice-call.e2e.test.ts snapshot
why: so a bun failure there is not caused by the port
result: recorded, do not attribute to bun

decision: runtime coupling is five sites, cli/bot.ts already spawns itself generically
why: decides the size of the port
result: autostart.ts:48, cli/bot.ts:63, cli/bot.ts:203-204, harness.ts:538, harness.ts:596, plus execFile duplicates in 12 test files

decision: kept Node supported and added Bun, rather than Bun only
why: the published npm package is installed by users who may have no Bun, and this is a one way door
result: assumption stated for the user to overrule

decision: Node suite on knockon: 47 of 50 files pass, 3 pre-existing failures, 310s
why: the before value for every later comparison
result: preference-commands agent-variant snapshot, voice-call finished-threads snapshot, catalog-refresh bulk write race
